whatIsCoffi.question: What is Coffi?
whatIsCoffi.answer: Coffi is a platform designed to help digital nomads and remote workers discover ideal spots for work, study, and relaxation. It combines curated spot information with real-time insights provided by the community.

isCoffiFree.question: Is Coffi free to use?
isCoffiFree.answer: Yes. With Explorer you find the right space to create, see how each space feels in real time, check in, see who's there with you and let your people find you while you earn Coffi Points. If you want to find your people before you head out and see who's at every space without checking in, there's Nomad.

personalInfo.question: What personal information does Coffi collect?
personalInfo.answer: Coffi collects basic personal information like your name and email when you create an account. It may also collect data about how you use the platform, your device information, and cookies to improve the service.

dataProtection.question: How does Coffi protect my data?
dataProtection.answer: Coffi implements reasonable security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. However, no method of online data storage is completely secure, so we encourage you to use strong passwords and keep your account credentials private.

thirdParties.question: Does Coffi share my information with third parties?
thirdParties.answer: Coffi may share your information with trusted third-party service providers to improve its services or comply with legal obligations. Rest assured, your data will never be sold for marketing purposes.

whoCanSeeMe.question: Who can see me on Coffi, and how do I hide?
whoCanSeeMe.answer: When you check in and show up in your room, people at that space can find you, and so can Nomad members looking for their people before they head out. They see your name, photo, profession, what you came to do, when you arrived and whether you're on a break, only while your room is open. Once you've been visible for a while, you start earning Coffi Points. If you'd rather not appear, turn off "Visible in this room" anytime: no one will see you, here or in the city, and you still count, without your name, in the space graphs.

whoCanSeeMeNomad.question: If I'm Nomad, who sees me?
whoCanSeeMeNomad.answer: When you show up in your room, people at that space can find you. "Visible in the city" is already on, so other Nomad members can find you from outside, before they arrive; you can turn it off anytime. Hide in your room and you're hidden everywhere, and you still see who chose to be found. And when you look at a space from outside, no one there sees you looking.

whichPlans.question: What plans does Coffi have?
whichPlans.intro: Today you can choose between two.
whichPlans.explorer: Explorer, free: let yourself be found in your room and earn Coffi Points for check-ins, reviews and the time you stay findable.
whichPlans.nomad: Nomad: find your people before you head out, see who's at every space without checking in, filter the city by profession and purpose, other Nomad members can find you across the city too with "Visible in the city", already on and yours to turn off anytime, and earn double Coffi Points on most actions.

cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. However, refunds are subject to Coffi's refund policy.

upgrade.question: How do I switch to Nomad?
upgrade.answer: In the app, tap "See Nomad", or go to the Nomad page on our website (/subscribe-nomad-plan). The change applies right away, even if your room is already open.

contribute.question: Can I contribute real-time updates to Coffi?
contribute.answer: Yes! You can contribute real-time insights about the spots you visit, such as noise levels, available seating, or Wi-Fi strength. These updates help the Coffi community stay informed.

rewards.question: Are there rewards for contributing updates?
rewards.answer: Yes! By contributing real-time updates or discovering new spots, you earn Coffi Points, which can be redeemed for exclusive features, badges, or other rewards.

inappropriateContent.question: What happens if I post inappropriate content?
inappropriateContent.answer: Posting offensive, false, or illegal content is prohibited and may result in account suspension or termination.

forgotPassword.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
forgotPassword.answer: You can reset your password by clicking the "Forgot Password" link on the login page and following the instructions sent to your registered email address.

deleteAccount.question: How can I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: If you wish to delete your account, you can do so by going to your profile settings or contacting us at help@coffi.com for assistance.

technicalIssues.question: Who do I contact for technical issues?
technicalIssues.answer: For any technical issues, feel free to reach out to our support team at help@coffi.com.
